name: Inflection End-to-End Daily ETL + Gold/Platinum Separation
description: Structural completion of daily Inflection ETL beyond bronze tier (INFINGE). Authorizes (a) automated daily gold chain trigger via EventBridge cron + nightly fallback + S3-event sentinel pattern (mirrors BD bd-canonical-prices-daily / bd-gold-nightly-fallback); (b) gold-completion sentinel write in orion-gold-dispatch.sh (currently MISSING — structural prerequisite for any S3-event-driven publisher chain); (c) full implementation of inf-portal-publisher and inf-portal-advisor-publisher Lambdas (currently STUBs returning {status:stub}); (d) Time Machine version capture (port bd-capture-output-versions); (e) gold/platinum separation enforcement — every Inflection portal API GW route migrated to read from platinum/* only; gold/ becomes strict internal staging tier; (f) weekly parity check Sunday cron (BD parity); (g) optional standalone price refresh gated on Phase 0 Orion REST sufficiency check.
source_brief: DS~A 5-gap MCP analysis 2026-05-07 + Andrew direct directive 'all pipelines running daily, gold runner running daily, proper separation between gold and platinum, ONLY PLATINUM OUTPUTS ARE FED TO PORTAL'
phase: Phase 1 — **PRD v0.2 SHIPPED 2026-05-07T~18:00Z (1.0.0_SA_CTO).** Andrew architectural revision via COO 17:50Z: event-chain primary + cron 06:00 UTC fallback (DISABLED) + INFINGE Phase 1b path-1 (orchestrator-dim migration) ABSORBED into INFETL.LAMBDA-DIMS. **COO 5-TO Series 2 SOLIDIFY dispatch 17:30Z** (Andrew 'barrel through all of this'): INFETL.DAILY-AUDIT (AE 0.7 per-dim matrix) + INFETL.LAMBDA-DIMS (AE 0.7 8 per-dim Lambdas bronze+silver one shot, absorbs INFINGE Phase 1b path-1) + INFETL.SILVER-AGGREGATOR (AE 0.7 N/N sentinel detection) + INFETL.GOLD-EVENT-TRIGGER (AE 0.7 event-mode + cron fallback DISABLED) + INFETL.SHAPE-VERIFY (DS~A per-dim verify + weekly cron alarm). Plus paired Series 1 RECTIFY 5-TO dispatch under sibling project ADVI_INFNNA (INFNNA.SILVER + INFNNA.GOLD + INFNNA.UAD-CREATOR + INFNNA.GUARDS-AUDIT + INFNNA.PORTAL-VERIFY) — INFETL Phase 1 ship gates on INFNNA Series 1 RECTIFY completing. **v0.2 architectural revision rationale:** Orion REST data-arrival timing non-deterministic (vs BD Schwab clock-anchored 21:38-22:30Z weekdays); event-chain is responsive (gold runs the moment silver is N/N complete, not on clock); cron 06:00 UTC survives as fallback (DISABLED until empirical validation); failure-mode containment via M<N silver-aggregator wait + per-dim CW alarm. **Tonight cascade ETA ~21:00-22:00Z** — txn full-history 1.15M rows incl Joe Brandenburg rep_id=6 + accounts_v2 INFLECTION_REP_IDS={3,6,11,12} filter (848 rows / $203.2M canonical) already done; tax+perf bronze ETA ~3h, billing bronze ETA ~2.4h, then full silver→gold→portal cascade. **Cron-flip-ack TO (ADVI_INFETL.011)** held in CTO queue per RAVC2 inline spec; COO drafts file post INFNNA.GOLD RAVC ACK; flips fallback cron DISABLED→ENABLED post 4-gate prerequisite stack. **Triggering incident:** Joe Brandenburg accounts retroactively re-attributed in Orion rep_id=3 (IWM) -> rep_id=6 within last few days; bronze pull script hardcodes @RepIDs='3,11,12' (excludes 6); silver/transactions + canonical_nna carry stale IWM-aggregated data; portal NMNC/NNA inconsistency ($19.7M NMNC vs -$1.36M NNA) is surface symptom; **structural root cause is daily Inflection ETL never re-runs gold end-to-end against current bronze**. 5-same-class incidents in 14 days. **Gold/platinum separation contract:** gold/ strict internal staging, only publishers may read; platinum/ is the read-only contract surface for portal; portal API GW must NOT read from gold/. Cross-pipeline note: BD currently writes gold/artifacts/*.json (does not honor this contract); harmonization OUT OF SCOPE for INFETL — defer BD migration as separate future project. **v0.1→v0.2 TO map:** v0.1 TO-1/2/5 → folded into INFETL.GOLD-EVENT-TRIGGER; v0.1 TO-3/4 → rescoped to INFNNA.GOLD (canonical_nna rebuild absorbs publisher impl); v0.1 TO-6/7/8/10 → DEFERRED to Phase 2 post event-chain empirical; v0.1 TO-9 → evolved into INFETL.SHAPE-VERIFY.
blocking: PRD v0.2 SHIPPED — 5-TO Series 2 SOLIDIFY decomposition dispatched by COO + 5-TO Series 1 RECTIFY dispatched under ADVI_INFNNA. Operational gates: (1) Series 1 RECTIFY (INFNNA.*) ships first → unblocks publisher impl absorbed into INFNNA.GOLD; INFETL Phase 1 gates on Series 1 completion. (2) Tonight cascade ETA ~21:00-22:00Z — full silver→gold→portal cascade for Joe Brandenburg rep_id correction. (3) Cron-flip-ack TO (ADVI_INFETL.011) gates on 4-prereq stack: INFNNA backfill RAVC ACCEPT + GOLD-EVENT-TRIGGER live empirical + manual sentinel emission fires publisher + aggregate sentinel observed firing event-trigger empirically.
